notes.scope: Trades that actually moved players between teams. Vetoed, canceled, declined and unanswered proposals are excluded.
notes.seasons: 2018-2023 and 2026. ESPN returns no transaction or weekly roster data for 2010-2017; 2024-2025 were on Sleeper.
notes.confidence: 'confirmed' = ESPN has a completed trade record. 'likely' = no ESPN trade record exists, but the weekly rosters show players swapping directly between the same two teams in the same week, which a waiver drop and pickup does not normally produce. ESPN's transaction log is incomplete, so many real trades only appear this way.
notes.detection: Roster-based detection compares each team's roster week to week (and week 1 against the draft). A group is counted only when players moved BOTH directions between the same two teams in the same week, and not when every move is explained by a waiver or free-agent record.
notes.limits: Likely trades have no dates or proposer, because no ESPN record exists. Two separate trades between the same two teams in the same week would be merged into one. A trade whose players moved again immediately may be missed.
notes.items: Each item is one player moving. 'dropped: true' means the player was released from the sending team as part of the trade (to is null); only confirmed records carry these.
notes.dates: ISO timestamps in UTC. week is the NFL week the move was logged or detected in.
notes.owners: ownerName normalized the same way as the rosters and draft files.
